name: Super Battery
author: Paul Bob
description: Omarchy's battery popup, plus low battery alerts with built-in sounds or your own songs, an auto power saver and a charge limit. Every setting is in the popup.

barWidget.description: Replaces the Power widget: the same battery popup, with Alerts (warning and critical sounds, including your own files) and Automations (auto power saver, charge limit) sections you set right there.
